SELECT h.yrt_id AS yrtId, e.emp_name AS empName, e.emp_no AS empNo, d.dept_name AS deptName, h.biz_place AS bizPlace, h.tax_apply_type AS taxApplyType, h.tax_apply_result AS taxApplyResult, h.confirm_yn AS confirmYn FROM yrt_header h JOIN emp e ON h.emp_id = e.emp_id LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id
AND d.dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
AND e.emp_name LIKE '%' || #{empName} || '%'
